questions.question:
D3 — Issue 1: Make Save the single filled primary action in the header?
Project/branch/task: Settings page redesign on main; Pass 1 (Information Architecture), the Visual Hierarchy gap listed in PLAN.md.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel, and Export look identical, so a user scanning the header has to read all four labels to find the one that stores their work. Users scan, they do not read; the most important action should be the most visible one. DESIGN.md already says Save is the only filled #1d4ed8 button with white text and the other three are neutral ghost buttons. Principle: hierarchy as service; users satisfice, so make the right choice the most visible choice.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Users hesitate at the header, hit Reset or Cancel by mistake, and the destructive confirmations fire more often than they should.
Recommendation: 1A because it applies the token DESIGN.md already prescribes, with no new visual exploration.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=6/10, 1C=3/10
1A) Save filled primary, three ghost secondaries (recommended) (human: ~1h / CC: ~5min)
  ✅ Save is found in the 3-second scan on every viewport, including the full-width mobile Save
  ✅ Uses existing Button variants and the #1d4ed8 token, white-on-primary contrast is about 6.7:1
  ❌ Ghost buttons must be verified for 44px targets and visible borders at 320px
1B) Save primary, but keep Reset/Cancel/Export as-is (human: ~30min / CC: ~3min)
  ✅ Smaller change, only one button style moves
  ✅ Save still gains visual precedence over the other three
  ❌ Leaves three equally loud secondaries competing with each other, off the DESIGN.md spec
1C) Keep all four identical (decline) (human: 0 / CC: 0)
  ✅ No implementation work in this pass
  ✅ Preserves the current rendering exactly
  ❌ Ships a header with no primary action, contradicting DESIGN.md and this pass stays at 7/10
Net: apply the approved hierarchy now, or ship a header where nothing wins the scan.

options.label: 1A Save primary + ghosts (recommended)
options.description: Apply DESIGN.md: Save filled #1d4ed8/white; Reset, Cancel, Export neutral ghost buttons.

options.label: 1B Save primary only
options.description: Fill Save; leave the three secondary buttons in their current style.

options.label: 1C Decline
options.description: Keep all four header buttons identical; gap stays documented.
